scope: Source Merge/Abort and Stash Save/Apply/Pop/List entry, preserved native reviews, captured preferences and mutation/warning ownership
source_review: Commands/MergeCommand.cpp abort routing and normal Merge review
Commands/StashCommand.cpp editable msg and latest-stash Apply/Pop
AppUtils.cpp Merge/MergeAbort and StashSave/StashApply/StashPop dialog/result flows
implementation: Five typed source command names, with merge abort selecting the Abort review; msg is allowed only on Stash Save and no revision/message switches invented for Merge
Common path-file resolution preserves actions and exact message presets
Repeated command-owned Merge/Save requests preserve native drafts; Abort reuses the open repository review
Merge, Abort, Save and Restore consumers receive owning workspace preferences
Untracked warning replies capture request UUIDs, rejecting duplicate old responses after a newer warning starts
A workspace pending stash mutation refuses competing launches and acceptance of an already-open Save draft; existing completion, cancellation and source post-actions remain

debug_build.known_diagnostics: Local Xcode printed CoreSimulator version and driver exit-code-zero diagnostics; xcodebuild process exited 0.

scope: Real native command entry opens and preserves Merge/Abort/Save reviews without mutating before acceptance
Owning private preferences reach Merge, Abort and Restore; Save uses a private unsuppressed untracked warning
Accepted No Commit/No Fast Forward merge creates MERGE_HEAD, and accepted Abort restores worktree with HEAD unchanged
Edited Save message reaches a real stash; old warning reply cannot accept a newer request
Real Apply restores exact Unicode worktree bytes and retains stash; Pop restores bytes and removes stash; both expose result questions
Injected cancellable restore keeps a native owner live while a competing Pop launch and existing Save acceptance are refused, then cancels and settles active-operation count
Merge, Abort and all Stash command variants retain ordinary bare-repository working-tree eligibility
native.cleanup: Every receiver reaped; independent ps exit 1 and empty stdout. Receiver-owned windows, private preferences, temporary repositories and helper processes only.

limits: No full source CLI/process/shared-switch or exit-code signaling parity claimed.
Mutation ownership guard is within this workspace, not an external-process lock or global cross-workspace serializer.
No physical Finder, minimum OS, every source layout, native picker gesture, real remote authentication or signed/App Store acceptance is established here.
Previous Merge history repair still requires hosted confirmation; queued CI is not a pass.
Current Release/unsigned App Store archive predates this batch. Custom TurtleGit artwork has not been recovered; the packaged artwork remains upstream.
